param: Λ Recruitment/birth inflow into child susceptible population (S_C).
β_C Effective transmission/contact rate for children (C). Force of infection uses (I_A + I_C).
β_A Effective transmission/contact rate for adults (A). Assumed lower than β_C.
ε Residual susceptibility factor for unmonitored-vaccinated classes U^V (leaky vaccine). Vaccine effectiveness = 1-ε.
δ Progression rate from exposed to infectious (E → I). Incubation ~10 days.
γ Recovery/transition rate from infectious to managed/immune infectious class (I → I_m). Recovery ~15 days.
ψ Maturation/aging rate from children (C) to adults (A), approx 1/(15 years).
ξ_U Rate at which susceptible children enter Unmonitored Vaccination Group (U_C^V).
ξ_M Rate at which susceptible children enter Monitored Vaccination Group (M_C^V).
ξ_A Rate at which susceptible adults enter Adult Vaccination Group (V_A) (catch-up vaccination).
η_U Rate at which unmonitored-vaccinated children (U_C^V) move to managed/immune infectious class (I_mC) (as drawn in figure; paper text uses h_U for immunization).
η_M Rate at which monitored-vaccinated children (M_C^V) move to managed/immune infectious class (I_mC) (paper text uses h_M for immunization).
η_A Rate at which vaccinated adults (V_A) and/or unmonitored-vaccinated adults (U_A^V) move to managed/immune infectious class (I_mA) (paper text uses h_A for immunization).
μ Natural death rate (applies to all human compartments in the full paper model; value mentioned as 1/(72*52) per week, but not explicitly tied to each compartment in extracted figure text).
α Disease-induced mortality rate (CFR-based) (mentioned in text but not fully visible in extracted equations).
